name: Shadow Leagues
background: The Gangs of New Eden are various factions of violent and deranged outlaws that wage eternal gang wars on the streets of New Eden. These gangs are joined by mercenaries which are not bound to any particular gang, and which fight for anyone that can provide riches or a worthy cause.

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Stealth Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Stealth. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Teleport
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, you may place this model anywhere fully within 3" of its position when using Advance/Charge actions, or fully within 6" of its position when using Rush actions.

specialRules.name: Ambush Re-Deployment
specialRules.description: Once per game, when a unit where all models have this rule ends its activation, you may immediately remove it from the table (dropping any objectives it might hold within 1"), and deploy it as if it had Ambush at the beginning of the next round.

specialRules.name: Shadow Operative
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy, as long as this unit hasn't started an activation yet this round, attackers get -4"/-2" range to a min. of 6" when shooting/charging it.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Shadow Operative
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Shadow Operative, attackers always get -4"/-2" range when targeting it from Shadow Operative (instead of only the first time they are attacked each round).

specialRules.name: Enhanced Shadow Operative Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Shadow Operative. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Shred when Shooting Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Shred when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Bane in Melee Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Bane in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Fearless Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Fearless. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Ignores Cover
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

specialRules.name: Purge
specialRules.description: When attacking units that are Shaken or Fatigued, this weapon gets AP(+2).

specialRules.name: Precision Debuff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which gets -1 to hit rolls when attacking once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Takedown Strike
specialRules.description: Once per game, when it's this model's turn to strike in melee, it may make X attacks at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown.

specialRules.name: Shrouded
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy, as long as this unit hasn't started an activation yet this round, attackers get -4"/-2" range to a min. of 6" when shooting/charging it.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Shrouded
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Shrouded, attackers always get -4"/-2" range when targeting it from Shrouded (instead of only the first time they are attacked each round).

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: Only deploys D3 rounds afters its wave, and at the start of the round it's placed within 6” of a random AI Goal.

specialRules.name: Stealth
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule are shot from over 9" away, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Shred
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.

specialRules.name: Bane
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

specialRules.name: Fear
specialRules.description: This model counts as having dealt +X wounds when checking who won melee.

specialRules.name: Fearless
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a Morale Test, roll one die. On a 4+ it counts as passed instead.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Takedown
specialRules.description: This model may pick any model in the target unit as its individual target for this weapon's attacks, which is resolved as if it was a unit of [1]. Takedown attacks must be resolved before other weapons.

specialRules.name: Deadly
specialRules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.
